propositions: A new immutable discovery kernel submodule must define typed plan/result/outcome contracts capturing unit identity, dependencies, blocking capability, budget estimates, and six outcome kinds (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) independent of existing verify/decide/coach symbols.

The executor must implement dependency-aware scheduling with deterministic budget-shed ordering (ascending dependency rank, then unit id), cascading skips for unmet dependents, and exact completed/failed/cancelled accounting on systemic failure or cancellation.

A versioned, digest-complete checkpoint/trace envelope must round-trip only success and content-identical resumed units; failed, cancelled, skipped, shed, corrupt, and legacy envelopes remain missing and cannot fabricate findings.
Stored trace must contain normalized outcome metadata and lineage (ids, outcomes, reason codes, usage) but exclude raw prompts, ticket/context bodies, provider responses, and secrets.
Cancellation must preserve non-interruptible already-dispatched calls as their true outcome with real usage while marking not-yet-dispatched units as cancelled.
The dependency graph and skipped-with-dependency-reason are stable contract for future migrations; current gates have empty graphs and independent fan-out with no behavior change until migration.
